test.create_query: CREATE TABLE decimal_parse_strings (d32 String, d64 String, i128 String, f128 String, i256 String, f256 String, z256 String) ENGINE = Memory

INSERT INTO decimal_parse_strings WITH if(number % 2, '-', '') AS sign, leftPad(toString(number), 9, '0') AS suffix SELECT concat(sign, toString(number), '.123'), concat(sign, '123456789.', suffix), concat(sign, repeat('1234567890', 2), '123456789', suffix), concat(sign, '12345678901234567890.123456789', suffix), concat(sign, repeat('1234567890', 6), '1234567', suffix), concat(sign, repeat('1234567890', 3), '12345678.', repeat('1234567890', 2), '123456789', suffix), concat(sign, '1.', repeat('0', 30), suffix) FROM numbers(100000)
test.query: SELECT count() FROM zeros(3000000) WHERE NOT ignore(toDecimal32OrZero(toString(rand() % 10000), 5))
